notes.decision: Verb of uncertain root, parsed as ⲁ-ϩ- (Lyc. 3pl perfect) + ⲩⲃⲧ + ϩ (Lyc. 3sg.f. object suffix = Sah. -ⲥ). Repeated ⲟⲩⲃⲏⲥ 'against her' across lines 5-6 establishes Hyle/Matter as object. Left untranslated; flagged.
Read as privative ⲁⲧ- + 3sg.f. suffix = 'without her,' though could be a verbal form. Modifies the preceding emanation-from-her clause: the elements emanate 'forth without her' into the smoke.
Four of the five Manichaean dark elements: fire (ⲧⲥⲉ = Sah. ⲥⲁⲧⲉ), wind (ⲡⲧⲏⲩ), water (ⲡⲙⲁⲩ), and Darkness (ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ). The fifth — ⲡⲕⲁⲡⲛⲟⲥ 'smoke' — was named in line 13. Standard 5-element inventory.
ⲭⲡⲁⲥ = Lyc. ϫⲡⲟ 'beget, bring forth' with 3sg.f. subject (ⲁⲥ-) and reflexive ⲟⲩⲁⲉⲉⲥ in line 19. The repeated formula ⲙⲡⲥⲏⲩ... ⲉⲧⲁⲥⲭⲡⲁⲥ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ marks two parallel acts of Hyle's bringing-forth.

notes.decision: ⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ from accumulated vocab = 'summon, call forth.' The fruits of Hyle 'are called forth in the manner of garments of the sons of the First Man' — the dark side imitates/mirrors the light cosmogony, where the First Man dons his Five Sons as armor (cf. tamion-passage, K.34).
ⲁⲭⲙ = Lyc. ⲉϫⲙ̄ 'upon.' The fruits/offspring fall upon the earth — the standard motif of the abortive archonic births in Manichaean cosmogony.
'the archon, the wellspring of all demons' — ⲡⲁⲛⲭⲱⲭ here is the dark Hyle/King of Darkness as source of all demonic emanations. Cf. accumulated entry: ⲡⲁⲛⲭⲱⲭ 'wellspring/source' tentative.

ⲫⲛⲁϩ likely = ⲁϥ-ⲡⲱⲍ/ⲡⲱϩ 'he reached' or ⲁϥ-ⲡⲏϩ 'he sprang/went' with directional ⲁϩⲟⲩⲛ 'into.' Translated 'went in unto.' The First Man dons his god-garments — i.e., the Five Light Sons as armor before the cosmic combat.
ⲡⲣ̄ⲓⲱⲩ = plural of ⲡⲣⲏ/ⲡⲣⲓⲉ 'sun, light' — 'the Lights' (cf. ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ 'the Radiance' in glossary). Here likely the divine Light-Emanations with whom the First Man speaks before descent.
